title: Java
focus: OOP fundamentals, JVM, types, collections framework, generics, streams, exceptions, concurrency basics, Maven/Gradle, common patterns; contrast with Python where useful.

title: C / C++
focus: Memory model, pointers, arrays, structs, manual memory management, C++ classes, RAII, references, templates, STL containers, smart pointers, compilation/linking, undefined behavior pitfalls.

title: JavaScript
focus: Modern ES2020+: types, closures, prototypes, this, event loop, promises/async-await, modules, DOM basics, fetch, array methods, common pitfalls; the language behind React/Node.

title: HTML & CSS
focus: Semantic HTML, forms, accessibility; CSS box model, flexbox, grid, responsive design, media queries, specificity, transitions, custom properties; practical layout patterns.

title: TensorFlow
focus: Tensors, tf.data pipelines, Keras API, building/training models, custom training loops, saving/loading, tf.function/autograph, GPU usage, TensorBoard, deployment (SavedModel, TFLite).

title: PyTorch
focus: Tensors, autograd, nn.Module, optimizers, training loops, DataLoader/Dataset, GPU/CUDA, saving checkpoints, torch.compile, inference; the dominant research framework.

title: scikit-learn
focus: Estimator API, fit/predict/transform, train/test split, pipelines, preprocessing, classic models (linreg, logreg, trees, RF, SVM, KNN, KMeans), metrics, cross-validation, grid search.

title: Hugging Face Transformers
focus: pipeline(), AutoModel/AutoTokenizer, model hub, tokenization, inference, fine-tuning with Trainer, datasets library, PEFT/LoRA overview, text-generation, embeddings.

title: Keras
focus: Sequential & Functional API, layers, compile/fit/evaluate, callbacks, common architectures (MLP, CNN, RNN), regularization, saving, Keras 3 multi-backend.

title: Prompt Engineering
focus: Prompt anatomy, zero/few-shot, chain-of-thought, role/system prompts, structured output, prompt patterns, temperature/params, guardrails, evaluation, agentic prompting, pitfalls.

title: LangChain
focus: Core abstractions (models, prompts, output parsers, LCEL runnables, chains), retrievers, memory, tools & agents, LangGraph overview, RAG with LangChain, integrations.

title: Vector Databases (FAISS & ChromaDB)
focus: Embeddings & similarity, ANN indexes (flat, IVF, HNSW), FAISS API, ChromaDB API, metadata filtering, distance metrics, persistence, when to use which, scaling.

title: Large Language Models (GPT & LLaMA)
focus: Transformer architecture, attention, tokenization, pretraining vs fine-tuning, RLHF, context windows, sampling, GPT vs LLaMA families, open vs closed, inference cost, limitations/hallucination.

title: Pandas
focus: Series/DataFrame, indexing (loc/iloc), filtering, groupby, merge/join, pivot, missing data, apply/map, datetime, reading/writing CSV/Excel/SQL, performance tips.

title: NumPy
focus: ndarray, dtypes, vectorization, broadcasting, indexing/slicing, reshaping, aggregation, linear algebra, random, why vectorization beats loops; foundation of the PyData stack.

title: Matplotlib & Seaborn
focus: Figure/axes model, line/bar/scatter/hist, subplots, styling, Seaborn statistical plots (heatmap, boxplot, pairplot, regplot), choosing the right chart, good viz practices.

title: Jupyter Notebooks & Anaconda
focus: Notebook workflow, cells, magics, kernels, JupyterLab; Anaconda/conda environments, package management, conda vs pip vs venv, reproducibility, best practices.

title: React
focus: Components, JSX, props/state, hooks (useState/useEffect/useContext/useMemo/useRef), lists/keys, forms, lifting state, data fetching, routing overview, performance, common mistakes.

title: Node.js
focus: Event loop, modules (CommonJS/ESM), npm, async patterns, Express server, middleware, routing, REST endpoints, file/env, error handling, building an API backend.

title: Flutter
focus: Dart basics, widgets (stateless/stateful), layout, Material widgets, state management overview, navigation, async/futures, calling REST APIs, building cross-platform apps.

title: REST APIs
focus: REST principles, HTTP methods/status codes, resources & URIs, request/response, JSON, auth (API keys, JWT, OAuth), versioning, pagination, idempotency, designing & documenting (OpenAPI), testing.

title: SAP BTP
focus: SAP Business Technology Platform overview, environments (Cloud Foundry, Kyma, ABAP), services, Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model, destinations, XSUAA auth, extension vs side-by-side, Fiori/UI5 context.

title: SAP AI Core
focus: SAP AI Core & AI Launchpad, running/serving ML workflows, generative AI hub, orchestration, connecting foundation models, resource groups, deployments, when to use in SAP landscape.

title: Microsoft Azure
focus: Core services (compute VM/App Service/Functions, storage, networking, AAD/Entra, resource groups), regions, pricing model, Azure CLI/portal, IaaS vs PaaS, deployment basics.

title: Azure AI Services
focus: Azure AI (Cognitive) Services, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (RAG), AI Foundry/ML studio, vision/language/speech APIs, keys & endpoints, responsible AI, integrating into apps.

title: MySQL
focus: Relational model, SQL (SELECT/JOIN/WHERE/GROUP BY/aggregates), DDL, keys, indexes, normalization, transactions/ACID, subqueries, views, query optimization, connecting from Python/Node.

title: Excel & Word
focus: Excel: formulas, references, key functions (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP/IF/SUMIF/INDEX-MATCH), pivot tables, charts, data cleaning; Word: styles, templates, formatting, references/TOC, collaboration; productivity tips.

title: WordPress & Elementor
focus: WordPress dashboard, posts/pages, themes, plugins, users, SEO basics; Elementor page builder: widgets, sections, responsive editing, templates, building a site without code.

title: Eclipse IDE
focus: Workspaces & projects, perspectives, editor features, build/run/debug, breakpoints, refactoring, plugins/marketplace, Java & SAP (ADT) usage, useful shortcuts.

title: Git & GitHub
focus: Repos, staging/commits, branches, merge vs rebase, remotes, push/pull, resolving conflicts, .gitignore, tags, GitHub PRs/flow, undoing mistakes (reset/revert/stash), best practices.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer Playbook
focus: What an FDE is (Palantir/AI-startup style), customer-facing engineering, discovery & requirements, rapid prototyping, deployment in customer environments, stakeholder communication, ownership, the skills/mindset, day-in-the-life, how to prepare and interview for FDE roles.

title: Machine Learning Core Concepts
focus: Supervised vs unsupervised vs RL, features/labels, train/val/test, overfitting & bias-variance, regularization, gradient descent, loss functions, evaluation metrics (accuracy/precision/recall/F1/ROC-AUC/RMSE), feature engineering, the end-to-end ML lifecycle.

title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
focus: Neurons/layers, activations, forward/backprop, optimizers, CNNs (vision), RNN/LSTM (sequence), attention & transformers, embeddings, regularization (dropout/batchnorm), transfer learning, training tips, when deep learning is/ isn't the answer.

title: MLOps & Productionizing ML
focus: ML lifecycle in production, experiment tracking, data/model versioning, pipelines, CI/CD for ML, model serving (batch/online), monitoring & drift, feature stores, reproducibility, LLMOps specifics, tooling landscape.

title: Communication & Public Speaking
focus: Structuring ideas (pyramid principle), storytelling, explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences, active listening, presentation design & delivery, managing nerves, body language & voice, meetings/standups, written communication, giving demos, practice drills.

title: System Design (Interview Prep)
focus: Interview framework, requirements & estimation, building blocks (load balancers, caching, DB SQL vs NoSQL, sharding/replication, queues, CDN), consistency/CAP, scalability, API design, a worked example (e.g. URL shortener / news feed), ML/LLM system design, and how to communicate a design.
